title: Several customers can be flagged and search finds them
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, flagged as an Internal customer.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Customers list.
  2. Search for customer B's name.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A and customer B both show the "Internal" badge in the list.
  • The list has no filter for internal customers.

Step 2:

  • Customer B is found and shows the "Internal" badge.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R9: “More than one customer can be flagged, in the modal or one by one on Edit Customer. Each carries the badge of S1-R8; there is no list of flagged customers anywhere but the Customers list itself.”
  • Feature Overview, Out of Scope: “A filter on the customers list. v1 shows the badge; search finds the flagged customers.”
